import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
import planner
from gen2 import gen_case
from probability import window_thresholds
import numpy as np

def run(J, S, F, G, cap, tok, seeds=2, span=None):
    for seed in range(seeds):
        rng = random.Random(seed)
        case = gen_case(rng, J, S, F, G, span=span)
        for s in case['slots']:
            s[1] = cap
        case['bucket'] = [tok, rng.randint(0, tok)]
        n = len(case['windows'])
        t0 = time.time()
        feats = np.array([w[7] for w in case['windows']], dtype=np.int64).reshape(n,9,2)
        preds = __import__('testcnnonnx' if case['model']=='cnn' else 'testrnnonnx').evaluate_model_single_pass(feats, np.zeros(n,dtype=np.int64))
        res = planner.solve_epoch(case)
        t2 = time.time()
        print('seed %d J=%d S=%d cap=%d tok=%d ratio=%s served=%d plan=%.2f' % (
            seed, n, S, cap, tok, res['ratio'], sum(1 for a in res['assignment'] if a>=0), t2-t0))
if __name__ == '__main__':
    J=int(sys.argv[1]); S=int(sys.argv[2]); F=int(sys.argv[3]); G=int(sys.argv[4])
    cap=int(sys.argv[5]); tok=int(sys.argv[6]); seeds=int(sys.argv[7]) if len(sys.argv)>7 else 2
    span = int(sys.argv[8]) if len(sys.argv)>8 else None
    run(J,S,F,G,cap,tok,seeds,span)
